transcript: Stop using Canva or Figma to make designs like it's 2023 because there's a slash command that you can use in Claude to make designs and also edit them right inside Claude. So just slash design, paste your reference designs and type in your prompt, and it will create multiple versions of your design inside a canvas. Since Claude knows your projects, files, colors, and fonts, it will save you hours in the process. You can also point it to any website, pull its brand identity, and generate multiple versions of that design. Then select one design, drag and drop, and you can make changes all without leaving Claude. And not only that, if you type slash design sync, it can turn your code into a design system right inside the Claude design interface. And if you want the guide how to set it up, just comment design and I'll send you the link.
caption:
You can now design right inside Claude (not Claude Design)

These are the two commands from the reel:

→ /design turns your ideas into posters, layouts, and UI mockups on a visual canvas.
→ /design-sync brings your existing React design system into Claude Design.

I made a free guide covering setup,
